description: Every stored family of the AAC store (docs/store.md 2.7): its key, value encoding, producer, retention and authority. Every redb table is derived_rebuildable from the logs, except act_live (volatile_live: the last read time, refreshed by every read).
release: store/release holds 1 for a store this build created; a store with logs or a redb file and no marker, or another release, was written by an unreleased test build and is refused at open and restore, untouched

events.payload: native/aac-store/src/usage.rs SampledBatch {observations: [Sampled]}: every changed account of one sampling tick
events.producer: usage::record (the analytics sampler and the backfill)
events.dedupe: the projector's per-account rule: sampled time never goes back, an unchanged sample is skipped
events.retention: forever by default; positive configured retentionDays is explicit opt-in

events.payload: native/aac-store/src/usage.rs SeenBatch {accounts: [Seen]}: every unchanged account of one sampling tick
events.retention: forever by default; positive configured retentionDays is explicit opt-in

events.payload: {day, part, parts, series[{account, window, hours[{hour, rollup}], day_rollup, periods[{start_ms, period}]}]}; a rollup is a 12-element array (usage.rs rollup_to_json)
events.producer: usage::close_days (maintenance, 2 h after a UTC day ends)

events.payload: accepted normalized report revision: kind, writer, objectId, seq, writtenAtMs, observedAtMs, sourceSha256, ids, doc
events.dedupe: kind + writer + objectId + source sequence + full source SHA-256

events.log: readings, or ledger when every hour in it belongs to a closed day
events.payload: native/aac-store/src/activity.rs CellsEv {c, t, put[CellEv], del[DelEv], s[SessEv]}: the cells and sessions of one computer and tool that one ingest changed; text, never dictionary ids. 1.1.0 adds q (quality bits, contract QUALITY_FLAGS) to CellEv and SessEv, absent when clean; 1.0.0 events read as clean
events.dedupe: the ingest writes only cells that differ; replace, raise and settle rules (12.3)
events.retention: kept for good (readings log, raw changes; the store keeps raw history unless an explicit retention is set); closed days also in the ledger

events.payload: {reads[{c, t, at, state, cause, complete, cover_from_h, cover_to_h, counts, roots, kind}]}: scan-state history; at is never after the store's clock, and counts.future_dated is the records left out as dated more than five minutes after it
events.producer: activity::ingest, when a source's state, cause or completeness changes, its covered span reaches a new hour, or an hour passed

events.payload: {day, part, parts, src[CellsEv]}: every cell of a UTC day, and the sessions that last moved in it
events.producer: activity::close_days (maintenance, 74 h after a UTC day ends)

events.payload: {c, t, state, files_read, files_total, oldest_h, cause, at, started}

tables.name: meta
tables.notes: store_schema_version, instance_id, created_ms, clean_shutdown, closed_through_day, last_*_ms; ts:* keys are the TypeScript side's (backfill markers)

tables.name: idem
tables.notes: reserved for ledger events with idempotency keys (phase 2 onward)

tables.name: series
tables.query: series list; all accounts at time T

tables.name: series_by_provider
tables.key: p u32 | a u32 | w u32

tables.name: reading_day
tables.key: a u32 | w u32 | day u32
tables.value: packed spans v1 (src/pack.rs): version, count, then per span the distance from the span before, its length, a changed-field mask and only the changed fields; holds closed spans only
tables.query: an account and window over a time range (one value per day in the range); all series at time T and the oldest reading (a seek per series); pruning (each series' days through the cutoff)
tables.retention: forever by default; positive configured retentionDays opts into legacy pruning (current span stays)

tables.name: latest
tables.value: t_first u64 | period_start u64 | binary Row v1: version, flags, presence mask, last_seen u64, then the present f64/i64 fields
tables.query: the latest reading per account; each series' open span, which is only here

tables.name: account_latest
tables.query: account status now; the change decision

tables.name: account_state
tables.value: binary AccountState v2 (30 bytes): version, status/platform/active flags, interned source u32, observed_ms/last_seen/last_observed i64; reads legacy msgpack v1 during bounded maintenance migration
tables.retention: forever by default; positive configured retentionDays opts into legacy pruning (current span stays)

tables.name: period
tables.key: a u32 | w u32 | t_start u64
tables.retention: kept for good (final periods through usage.day_closed)

tables.name: rollup_hours
tables.key: a u32 | w u32 | day u32
tables.value: packed hours v1 (src/pack.rs): version, 24-bit mask of the hours present, then their binary Rollup v2 values
tables.query: burn over any span, hourly charts (one value per day in the range)

tables.name: rollup_day
tables.key: a u32 | w u32 | day u32
tables.value: binary Rollup v2: presence mask varint, then the present fields (percentages f32, whole ones as a varint; credits f64, whole or hundredth ones as a varint)

tables.name: finding
tables.notes: disclosed loss findings kept across opens; rebuilt from the ledger's store.integrity_detected

tables.name: capture_revision
tables.key: object sha256[32] | source seq u64 BE | full source sha256[32]
tables.value: versioned msgpack metadata, correlation ids and content hash; source/observed/ingested clocks

tables.name: capture_content
tables.value: u8 codec (1 raw/2 zstd3) | raw length u32 BE | canonical msgpack document (compressed only when smaller)

tables.name: capture_by_time
tables.query: future time-range capture/replay tools; kept transactionally with revisions

tables.name: act_dict
tables.notes: the activity projector's own dictionary (1 computer, 2 tool, 3 route, 4 model, 5 account, 6 effort, 7 session signature): a usage rebuild never touches it

tables.name: act_hour
tables.key: day u32 | computer u32 | tool u32
tables.value: packed cells v2 (activity.rs encode_cells): version, count, then per cell hour u8, session key 8 bytes, route/model/effort/account ids, four token varints, then reasoning, logged cost, cost, fallback cost (nano-dollars) and events, each varint+1 with 0 for unknown, then the quality bits varint; v1 values (no quality) read as clean
tables.query: every Analytics range: one value per day and source in the range
tables.retention: kept for good unless AAC_ANALYTICS_RETENTION_DAYS is set

tables.name: act_session
tables.value: msgpack SessionRow {c, hs, f, l, p[{r, m, i, o, cw, cr, ln, cn, fb}], tg, cwk, cwp, q}

tables.name: act_session_by_last
tables.key: last hour u32 | tool u32 | session key [u8; 8]
tables.value: first ms u64 | last ms u64 | signature id u32 (a covering index)
tables.query: sessions active in a range, counted by signature without reading a row

tables.name: act_cover
tables.key: computer u32 | tool u32 | start hour u32
tables.query: gaps and the oldest data per computer

tables.name: act_source
tables.value: msgpack SourceRow {first_h, last_h, settle_h, last_complete, read, bad_since}
tables.query: settle line, last read, oldest stored hour

tables.name: act_day_closed
tables.notes: days whose cells are final in the ledger

tables.name: act_scan
tables.key: computer u32 | tool u32 | at ms u64

tables.name: act_live
tables.notes: minute-precision last read, written on every ingest without a log event; after a rebuild act_source.read answers at hour precision until the next read
